runtime.command_template: python -B tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game clas1812 --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <state-directory> --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/gts3/class-of-1812-<name>.json --dmd-dir <frames> --output <external-run.json>. The nvram-init run starts from an empty state directory (state-init-clas1812) and loads factory settings; every other run starts from a new state directory (states/clas1812-<name>) holding only that NVRAM. Every scenario sets switch_converter gts3, so the harness checks PINMAME_HARDWARE_GEN_GTS3 before touching a switch.
